name: haiku-rag
title: Haiku RAG
description: Search your own files by meaning and open the exact page and passage.
author: tolgaerdonmez

commands.name: search-documents
commands.title: Search Documents
commands.subtitle: haiku.rag
commands.description: Search the indexed folders and open a result at the exact spot.

commands.name: manage-folders
commands.title: Manage Indexed Folders
commands.subtitle: haiku.rag
commands.description: List, add and remove the folders haiku.rag indexes.

preferences.name: serviceUrl
preferences.title: Search Service URL
preferences.description: Base URL of the local haiku.rag search service.

preferences.name: serviceToken
preferences.title: Service Token
preferences.description: Bearer token, when the service sets ingester.api.auth_token.

preferences.name: useMockData
preferences.title: Mock Data
preferences.label: Use built-in sample results instead of the service
preferences.description: For development without a running search service.

preferences.name: resultLimit
preferences.title: Result Limit
preferences.description: How many passages to fetch per query, grouped by file (at most 50).

preferences.name: rexPath
preferences.title: Rex CLI
preferences.description: Path to the rex command used to open text files in Neovim. Empty finds the CLI bundled with Rex.

preferences.name: rexSession
preferences.title: Rex Session
preferences.description: Rex session that receives the Neovim tabs; created when missing.

preferences.name: editorCommand
preferences.title: Editor
preferences.description: Editor started in the Rex tab, run through your login shell.

preferences.name: openRouterApiKey
preferences.title: OpenRouter API Key
preferences.description: Used only by "Ask About This Result".

preferences.name: askModel
preferences.title: Ask Model
preferences.description: OpenRouter model id for "Ask About This Result".

preferences.name: monthlySpendCapUsd
preferences.title: Monthly Spending Cap (USD)
preferences.description: Asking stops once this month's OpenRouter spend reaches the cap.
